normativeDefinition: A world region used as a coherent settlement or land-use subdivision.

necessary: A candidate must satisfy this concept-specific identity condition: A world region used as a coherent settlement or land-use subdivision.
Its space identity must persist independently of temporary state, contextual role, visual style, and realization form.
excludes: A candidate whose primary identity belongs to an upper sort other than space is excluded.
A candidate related only by part, membership, location, attachment, support, temporary state, treatment, or contextual role is excluded.
